verdict_reason: The code implements the explicitly named BLME self-versus-perturbed embedding diagnostic: it normalizes one Gaussian matrix direction to the requested relative Frobenius norm and computes top-k neighbor-set Jaccard as |A intersect B|/(2k-|A intersect B|). Independent set calculations matched exactly, and the realized 0.01 perturbation ratio differed by at most 2.8e-9 on the four allowed models; no value-changing implementation counterexample remains.
comparable_reason: The normalization removed the prior sqrt(d_model) noise growth: at fixed V=3000, widths 16,32,64,128,256,512 gave Jaccard 0.9644,0.9692,0.9679,0.9671,0.9687,0.9679 (Spearman rho=0.143; range 0.0048). Candidate vocabulary still matters: at fixed d=64, V=1000,2000,5000,10000 gave 0.9715,0.9704,0.9639,0.9629 (rho=-1; range 0.0086), so compare only matched token populations and perturbation protocol.
github_reason: Fetched and inspected the code released with Wendlandt et al. It measures top-10 overlap between independently trained spaces and has no self-noise mode, so there is no like-for-like endpoint to run; algebraically, BLME's Jaccard is the monotone transform J=o/(2k-o) of equal-size neighbor overlap o.
paper_reason: Wendlandt et al. publish overlap percentages for independently trained word2vec/GloVe/PPMI spaces, not values for BLME's self-versus-normalized-noise diagnostic. Their Table-1 neighbor lists can validate the overlap-to-Jaccard transform, but no published number is a target for this quantity.
confounds_reason: The controlled width sweep was flat, and a seven-model current run had weak correlations with d_model (rho=-0.222), n_layers (-0.165), and vocab_size (0.060). The controlled vocabulary sweep was nevertheless monotone (rho=-1, 0.0086 span), and tokenization changes both the candidate universe and row identity, so residual vocabulary architecture dependence is real but not dominant in the sampled zoo.
defects: The score is not Wendlandt et al.'s independently-trained-space stability; it is correctly labeled as a BLME synthetic robustness diagnostic, so the two must not be interchanged.
A single perturbation seed is treated as the estimate, while stability_std is dispersion across token rows rather than uncertainty across perturbation replicates.
The reference-model branch aligns rows by raw token ID, which is invalid when tokenizers or vocabulary order differ.
The unadjusted top-k Jaccard has a vocabulary-size/candidate-set null and requires 1 <= k < V; comparisons need matched token populations or a chance-adjusted companion output.
